purpose: One-factor sensitivity anchored to the frozen primary comparison Full model; independent of replacement ablation execution

decomposition.ACSim: independently fitted prefix-causal DWC/EDC decomposition on ACSim training devices
decomposition.ACCom: independently fitted prefix-causal DWC/EDC decomposition on ACCom training devices
decomposition.ACAll: independently fitted pooled prefix-causal DWC/EDC decomposition on ACAll training devices

shared_settings.target: RUL cycles divided by train-only maximum initial RUL plus one
shared_settings.metric_aggregation: prefix metrics per device/seed, then average seeds within device, then average devices

execution_rules: Run ACSim, ACCom, and ACAll separately using their final decomposition paths.
Change exactly one registered factor per run.
Do not use --shared-decomposition for any condition.
Do not reuse old sensitivity predictions as final evidence.
Report RMSE, MAE, P90AE and device-level bootstrap intervals for all three conditions.
Freeze the selected configuration using inner-development data before outer-test evaluation.
